Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Changelog: 0.3.11.0 — Current updates after Full/Auto cycle reprices; the undercut (!) marker stays until the next scan. Low stock refreshes after Restock/List without Refresh all. ETA for running jobs. Earning (teal) for items with no recorded cost, shown apart from profit. Today's market sales vs ours and a lost-sales list in the (!) popup and Sales tab. [Match bait] chat link and Reprice tab button: one-shot price match against a skipped bait listing. Optional (off by default): auto-restock low stock during Full/Auto cycle; reprice each retainer during AutoRetainer's bell visit (GatherBuddy Reborn friendly, skipped while Auto cycle is on). Safety: floor and price range re-checked before every price write.
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, sales tracking and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Reprice every retainer listing to the live market lowest -N gil with floor / max-drop guards, track each listing until it sells (reprices, competitors, days, gil), one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle at the summoning bell that waits for AutoRetainer. Timed automation is against the FFXIV ToS; use at your own risk.
